bounded_paper_tet_mp_check.interpretation: Selected center constitutive tangents agree with corrected MP IFT; selected centered ideal endpoint secants converge toward the MP IFT tangent over powers 18–26 without observed dl/y sign or FB denominator-path changes. This is bounded local evidence only.
bounded_paper_tet_mp_check.scope: six selected paper tets adjacent to largest corrected residual nodes; Decimal 90-digit IFT and exact ideal endpoints

corrected_replay.method: Evaluate the exact captured neo-Hookean glue stress at F0 +/- epsilon*dt*H for each of 192 glue tets and add the resulting gathered endpoint residual change. Paper endpoint projection/data remain those of the original run.

finding: The 002 and tight-003 ideal-FD runs perturbed F only for paper tets but compared their assembled residual derivative against a tangent action assembled over paper plus glue tets. The endpoint residual therefore omitted glue stiffness while the reference A included it.

qualification.no_changes: No native solver, material equations, gates, tolerances, or physical parameters were changed.
qualification.remaining: After correction, full-mesh p20–p26 mismatch ranges 7.5e-5–1.0e-3 relative to the assembled action; it remains above a 1e-6 FP64 derivative criterion, and the corrected p22 FD does not qualify the full tangent. Endpoint projection residual amplification and full mesh composition are not resolved here.
qualification.result: The large p20–p26 FD gap in the old comparison was caused by omitted glue endpoint deformation and is not evidence of a paper constitutive derivative defect.

reproduction: Run the corrected replay.py with the source-bound Python environment listed in the corrected package.
